title: Viwakilishi (Theme 1: Usafi wa sehemu za umma)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child tells a pronoun (standing for the noun) from an adjective (following it), and chooses person, demonstrative or number pronouns by class and number.
representations: sentence pairs with and without the noun
a class table of demonstratives and numbers
steps: Find the noun or its gap.
Is the word standing for a noun?

board.say: Neno hili linasimama badala ya nini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child labels three pronouns and rewrites one sentence with the noun.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kiwakilishi kipi cha nafsi ya kwanza wingi?" Kwa nini "wao" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Sisi ni nafsi ya kwanza wingi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kiwakilishi kipi cha kuonyesha mtu aliye karibu?" Kwa nini "yule" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kiwakilishi kipi cha idadi?" Kwa nini "huyu" si jibu sahihi?
Kuna nomino kabla ya neno hili?
misconceptions.repair: Neno la idadi likisimama badala ya nomino ni kiwakilishi.

checks.question: Ni kiwakilishi cha idadi kipi: "Watatu walichelewa."
